marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to northwest 15 knots this evening and to
northwest 25 late overnight. Wind diminishing to west 15 near noon Monday and to
light early Monday evening. Rain changing to periods of drizzle Monday morning. Fog
patches. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early Monday morning then
subsiding to 1 or less Monday afternoon.<br/>
